use_cases: Replacing default browser cursor with branded custom cursor for portfolio or creative websites
Adding interactive hover states to cursor elements in design tool interfaces
Creating differentiated mouse follower experiences in SaaS product landing pages
Implementing cursor text overlays for interactive showcase or tutorial experiences
ai_summary: A spring-physics animated custom cursor component that smoothly follows mouse movement with configurable variants and optional text display. Uses motion/react for fluid animations with mix-blend-difference styling for visibility on any background. Exports a hook pattern for managing cursor variants and text state across the application.
